summary: Two-hand Fury with a 3.7 sec axe in Berserker Stance: Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Flurry and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization. Shipped as the two-hand Fury variant; it trails dual wield Fury and Arms.
rotation: Start in Berserker Stance with no Rage; Battle Shout from the raid
Death Wish held for the last 36 sec, Recklessness for the last 30 sec
Blood Fury and Berserking held for the last 25 sec, Elune's Light with Death Wish; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 30 sec
Execute first in the execute phase
Bloodthirst, then Slam from 30 Rage right after a main hand swing, then Whirlwind at 25+ Rage
Heroic Strike queued from 70 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown

Rage from white hits is normalised to the weapon: k × swing speed (k 3.46 one-hand, 4.5 two-hand, measured at level 30), growing with level to ×1.5 at 60 (s = 0.5), the off hand the same. An assumption until measured at 60
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client attribute); Deep Wounds tick timer restarting on each crit is a modelling choice
Crit Rage bonus assumed white hits only; Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath (open assumptions)
One +2% crit elixir a character: whether Ferocity stacks with Mongoose in game is open; a second crit elixir (Grizzly) would add 12.0
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted (would add 8.8 at Undead 180 s)
The 36 sec Death Wish hold is +3.5 at 180 sec but -4 at 120 sec
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_fury_2h -apl level60_fury_2h -talents 30305013032-25053000152110501 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited. Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Uses the Fury class options (Berserker Stance) as the preset build does; the preset's DefaultConsumes keep an off-hand stone, which has no effect without an off hand.
